news.title: Nicholas Boggs receives 2026 Truman Capote Award from UI
news.summary_en: Nicholas Boggs, a writer and assistant professor of English and creative writing at Stony Brook University in Stony Brook, New York, has been selected as the 2026 recipient of the Truman Capote Literary Trust Award for Literary Criticism in Memory of Newton Arvin.

news.title: Iowa Writers’ Workshop alumna named finalist for National Book Award
news.summary_en: Poet Brenda Hillman, who earned an MFA from the University of Iowa Writers’ Workshop in 1976, is a 2026 finalist for the prestigious National Book Award.

news.title: REAPS efficiency review entering second phase
news.summary_en: The committee conducting the Iowa Board of Regents Revenue Enhancement and Productivity Study (REAPS) has identified nine areas for further exploration as the study enters its second phase.

news.title: College of Pharmacy ovarian cancer research moves to clinical trials
news.summary_en: A new approach to treating ovarian cancer has taken an important step forward. Research developed in the lab of Jill Kolesar, UI College of Pharmacy dean and Jean M. Schmidt Chair, has received FDA approval to move to clinical trials.

news.title: Iowa Veteran gets back in the game after targeted cancer treatment
news.summary_en: When Ron Watson’s prostate cancer persisted through several treatments, a targeted therapy available near his Ankeny home produced a remarkable response — and helped him return to the baseball field.

news.title: Photo gallery: Nothing to see here? We beg to differ
news.summary_en: From Caitlin Clark’s return to the excitement surrounding College GameDay and a marquee football matchup, it was a memorable weekend for Hawkeye fans.
